title: variadic overloads with the same tail type are duplicates
purpose: Variadic calls are positional, so parameter names cannot distinguish two variadic signatures of the same types.

failure.justification: A declaration-level rule checked after parsing; an implementation may also detect it at registration/runtime. The program must not complete.

provenance.origin: authored for typed and variadic overloads
provenance.expected_basis: spec 11.8.1: two variadic signatures with the same parameter types are the same signature.
